title: Reactivity of Organometallic Molybdate toward Lanthanide Cations. Synthesis and Structure of Polynuclear Lanthanide-Molybdate Complexes

synthesis.procedure: La(NO3)3·6H2O (0.360 g, 0.831 mmol) was dissolved in 10 mL of THF, and 3.6 mL of this solution was added dropwise over 1 min with stirring to [(n-C4H9)4N][Cp*MoO3] (0.240 g, 0.460 mmol in 10.0 mL of THF). After [(n-C4H9)4N]NO3 was filtered off, the remaining lanthanum solution was added over 1 min with stirring; a transient white precipitate redissolved to give a clear yellow solution. Toluene was added to saturation (ca. 54 mL) and the mixture stood at -10 °C for 18 h. Additional [(n-C4H9)4N]NO3 crystals were filtered off, 22.9 mL of toluene was added, the cloudy solution was filtered, and the yellow filtrate stood at ambient temperature to give yellow hygroscopic plate crystals (0.115 g, 0.0715 mmol, 31.1% based on Mo). After vacuum drying over P2O5 the bulk analyzed as [La3(Cp*MoO3)2(OH2)7](NO3)7·THF. Skipping the final filtration instead gave needle crystals (yield 55.0%) that, after standing about a week in mother liquor, converted to block crystals of the dimeric La compound.

reagents.name: lanthanum(III) nitrate hexahydrate

synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing with sequential addition and filtration of [(n-C4H9)4N]NO3
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Toluene layered/added to saturation; [(n-C4H9)4N]NO3 removed by filtration; yellow plate crystals from filtrate at ambient temperature. X-ray crystals formulated as the 4THF solvate.

material_class.structural_family: nitrate-bridged dimer of Cp*-protected Ln3Mo2 units

synthesis.procedure: Prepared from the same La(NO3)3·6H2O / [(n-C4H9)4N][Cp*MoO3] THF procedure as 1. When the final filtration of the cloudy toluene-containing solution was omitted, thin needlelike crystals formed (same IR and 1H NMR as the plates of 1; vacuum-dried analysis [La3(Cp*MoO3)2](NO3)7·2THF·5H2O; yield 55.0%). After those needles stood in mother liquor in a capped vial for about a week, block-shaped crystals of 2 appeared.

synthesis.procedure: Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.360 g, 0.829 mmol) was dissolved in 10.0 mL of THF, and 4 mL of this solution was added dropwise over 1 min with stirring to [(n-C4H9)4N][Cp*MoO3] (0.240 g, 0.460 mmol in 10.0 mL of THF). After [(n-C4H9)4N]NO3 was filtered off, the remaining cerium solution was added over 1 min. Toluene was added to saturation (ca. 74 mL) and the mixture stood 18 h at -10 °C. An oily bottom layer was removed by decantation, more toluene was added to saturation (ca. 9 mL), and the mixture was stored at -10 °C for 18 h then allowed to stand at ambient temperature. Yellow crystals appeared in 1 day (88 mg, 0.052 mmol, 23% based on Mo). Vacuum-dried bulk analyzed as [Ce3(Cp*MoO3)2](NO3)7·3THF·4H2O. Single-crystal composition is the mixed Ce3Mo2 salt with lattice THF.

reagents.name: cerium(III) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: 0.360 g, 0.829 mmol in 10.0 mL THF (4 mL added first, remainder after filtration)

synthesis.time: 18 h at -10 °C; additional 18 h at -10 °C after second toluene addition; crystals in 1 day at ambient temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing with filtration of [(n-C4H9)4N]NO3 and decantation of an oily phase
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Two toluene saturations at -10 °C with decantation of oil; yellow crystals from the solution at ambient temperature.
